issues.issue: This sentence makes the Agreement effective "as of its stated date of execution" (July 9, 2014), while Section 2 fixes an Effective Date of August 15, 2014 and Section 17 says employment becomes effective on the Effective Date. Which date governs the Agreement's operation is genuinely open.

The integration clause supersedes any "contemporaneous agreement ... oral or written", yet the NDA paragraph of Section 6 records an NDA executed "[s]imultaneously herewith" and treats it as operative (breach of it is Cause under Section 9(b)(v)). The survival of the NDA cannot be squared with this sentence.

Employment becoming effective on the Effective Date (August 15, 2014) has to be reconciled with Section 14, which makes the Agreement effective as of its stated date of execution, July 9, 2014. The instrument gives two effectiveness rules.

"Sections 4 through 18, inclusive" is a self-including and over-inclusive range — it survives Section 18 itself and the boilerplate sections — and "termination of the Executive" should read termination of his employment. The mechanical sloppiness changes what survives.

Making Section 4 (Compensation and Benefits) survive termination "in full force and effect" directly contradicts Section 5(b), under which all rights to salary, bonuses and other compensation payable after termination cease. Whether post-termination bonus is owed turns on that contradiction.
The parties merely "agree to work in good faith to amend this Agreement", an agreement to agree with no fallback if they cannot. What either party must actually do is not fixed.

Exhibit A describes accountability for the Telecom/Embedded Systems practice, while Section 3 permits the Board to assign Executive to "another management position"; the incorporated Exhibit and the flexible title provision pull in different directions. The tension is real but modest.

The duty list is expressly "without limitation", so the enumerated bullets do not bound the responsibilities, and terms such as "reliable forecasting" and "proper knowledge management" set no measurable standard. The open-ended catch-all against the specifics is the defect.
